narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Take two and six. Their average is four, which is even, so the claim is true.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Their average is three, which is odd, so one lucky pair proves nothing, and that slip is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check a claim, look for one pair that breaks it.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>If your pair works, try more, and then use letters to be sure.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu tries two and six, gets four, and says the claim is true. One example that works does not prove a claim, and two and four give three, which is odd.
